description: A comprehensive source file for the iOS NodeAppModel class managing device connections, capabilities, UI interactions, notifications, camera, location, and gateway communications within an OpenClaw project.

classes.name: NotificationCallError
classes.description: Represents errors during notification calls; encapsulates an error message.

classes.name: GatewayRelayIdentityResponse
classes.description: Decodable struct for gateway relay identity responses containing deviceId and publicKey.

classes.name: NotificationInvokeLatch
classes.description: Synchronization utility to wrap async notification calls, ensuring timely resumption.

classes.name: NodeAppModel
classes.description: Main ViewModel managing app state, gateway sessions, device capabilities, notifications, camera, location, and UI interactions.

methods.name: setScenePhase
methods.description: Handles app state changes between foreground and background, managing connections and services accordingly.

methods.name: setVoiceWakeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables voice wake functionality, considering interactions with other modes.

methods.name: setTalkEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the talk mode, updating persistent settings and notifying the gateway.

methods.name: requestLocationPermissions
methods.description: Requests necessary location permissions based on the specified mode.

methods.name: setSelectedAgentId
methods.description: Sets and persists the selected agent ID, updating dependent states and sharing settings.

methods.name: setGlobalWakeWords
methods.description: Sends a list of global wake words to the gateway, updating voice trigger configurations.

methods.name: startVoiceWakeSync
methods.description: Initiates synchronization for voice wake words and modes with the gateway.

methods.name: applyTalkModeSync
methods.description: Synchronizes the local talk mode state with the gateway.

methods.name: pushTalkModeToGateway
methods.description: Posts the current talk mode state to the gateway.

methods.name: startGatewayHealthMonitor
methods.description: Begins periodic health checks on the gateway connection.

methods.name: stopGatewayHealthMonitor
methods.description: Stops the periodic gateway health checks.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Main dispatcher for handling various command invocations, routing to specific handlers based on command prefix.
